title: The Falcon platform, deployed and managed
intro: As a CrowdStrike partner, we deploy and run the Falcon platform for you. One lightweight agent and one console cover endpoint, identity, and cloud, with AI native detection and a 24/7 team stopping breaches before they start. You get enterprise grade protection without building a security operations centre of your own.

pillars.title: Endpoint protection & EDR
pillars.desc: The market leader in endpoint protection and detection, backed by adversary intelligence and native AI.
points: Next generation antivirus that deploys in minutes
Endpoint and extended detection and response (EDR and XDR) in one
Device, firewall, and USB control from a single policy
Mobile protection for Android and iOS

pillars.title: Managed detection & response
pillars.desc: Falcon Complete Next-Gen MDR: an expert team watching your environment around the clock so you never have to.
points: 24/7 expert led, AI accelerated detection and response
Threats contained in your environment, not just alerted on
A documented response and escalation path
Backed by CrowdStrike's Breach Prevention Warranty

pillars.title: Threat intelligence & hunting
pillars.desc: Elite human threat hunters searching continuously for the faint signs of a sophisticated intrusion.
points: Coverage across endpoint, identity, and cloud
World class cyber threat intelligence built in
Proactive hunting, not just automated alerting
